evidence.scope: Register graphify for Claude Code and Codex, build and commit the graph of this repository, install the git hooks, run graphify extract --code-only in CI, and add harness graph as a thin wrapper that writes the answer into the journal.
acceptance: graphify claude install and graphify install --platform codex both succeed, and a graphify query in a Claude Code session answers about this repository: evidenced by the recorded command output and the MCP server appearing in claude mcp list

graphify hook install is in place and a commit changing harness/ updates graphify-out/graph.json in the same commit: evidenced by a real commit whose diff carries both. Re-pointed from packages/core, which arrives with SEEN-006

The MCP server exposes query_graph, get_neighbors, shortest_path and get_pr_impact, and a query for the stage gate returns its callers: evidenced by the recorded tool listing and the query output. Re-pointed from the policy gate, which arrives with SEEN-033
CI runs graphify extract --code-only and fails when the graph does not parse, and GRAPH_REPORT.md is an artefact of the run: evidenced by a green run and the artefact
harness graph SEEN-087 impact writes the impact set into the journal as a note: evidenced by the record it appends
decisions: SEEN-087 runs before SEEN-006 rather than after it, against the tree that exists: 100 documents and the harness. AC2 and AC3 are re-pointed at harness/ and the stage gate, and SEEN-006 carries a line to re-verify both against packages/core once the monorepo exists. Founder, 23 September 2026

CI runs graphify extract --code-only: local, deterministic, no API key and no per-build token spend, which is what the ticket's own principle asks for. The semantic pass over documents runs locally when someone chooses to. Founder, 23 September 2026

graphify claude install writes its own section and PreToolUse hook into CLAUDE.md, and the prose it inserts is then edited into the file's voice: British spelling, no dashes. The wiring stays whatever the tool expects. Founder, 23 September 2026

The MCP server is the graphify-mcp executable, not python -m graphify.serve as the ticket says: a uv tool install isolates the package so the system python cannot import it. Established from uv tool list and recorded in the note at record 2
graphify 0.9.65 is already installed on this machine, so the install step of the ticket is verification rather than installation
